definition: the act of moving or climbing upward

collocations.example: The old lift began its slow ascent to the top floor.

definition: to find out the true facts about something

collocations.example: Police are trying to ascertain the truth about the accident.
Engineers worked hard to ascertain the cause of the failure.

definition: to say that something is caused by or belongs to someone

collocations.example: Economists ascribe great importance to these new trade policies.

definition: onto or towards the land from the water

Pieces of the broken wreckage were washed ashore overnight.

definition: to attack someone or something violently

definition: of various different types; mixed

definition: a lack of balance or equality between two things

definition: giving good care and polite attention to someone's needs

definition: a room or space just below the roof of a house

They spent the weekend clearing out the dusty old attic.

definition: a short performance to test a performer's suitability

definition: to increase the size, value, or amount of something

definition: a special quality or feeling that surrounds a person

definition: very plain and simple, without any comfort or decoration

definition: respected and trusted as being accurate and true

definition: to prevent something bad or dangerous from happening

definition: extremely good, impressive, or enjoyable

definition: a first university degree below the level of a master's

definition: a strip of material used to cover or bind a wound

definition: a large formal meal for many people on a special occasion

definition: an outdoor meal at which food is cooked over an open fire

definition: a long flat-bottomed boat used on rivers and canals

definition: a group of buildings where soldiers live

definition: land that is too poor to produce plants or crops

definition: to hit someone or something very hard

definition: to signal to someone to come closer, usually with the hand

definition: an insect with hard wing covers over its back

Healthy trees can better fend off the destructive bark beetle.

definition: before a particular event or time; in advance

It is wise to plan every detail of the trip beforehand.

definition: to see or look at someone or something

Visitors travel far to behold the view at dawn.

definition: to shout something in a loud, deep voice

definition: kind, generous, and wanting to help other people

definition: gentle, kind, or not harmful in any way

The island enjoys a mild and benign climate all year.

definition: a small, round, juicy fruit without a stone

definition: to be careful about something dangerous or harmful

definition: a list of the books and sources used in a piece of writing

definition: relating to the number system of 0s and 1s used by computers

definition: the removal of tissue from the body for medical examination

definition: the organ in the body where urine is stored

definition: having little flavor, or lacking strong or interesting qualities

definition: done openly and without shame; very obvious

definition: a strong chemical used to clean or to make things white

definition: a state of perfect happiness and joy

definition: a sore bubble on the skin filled with liquid

definition: a group of countries or people united for a common purpose

definition: a detailed plan of how to achieve something

definition: an attempt to deceive someone by pretending something is true

definition: to move up and down quickly and gently

definition: a small enclosed space or stall for a particular purpose

definition: a town or a district of a large city with its own council

definition: a very large rock or stone

definition: a length of hair that has been woven into one piece

definition: a strong alcoholic drink made from wine

definition: the wide range or variety of something such as knowledge

definition: a flat case used for carrying documents and papers

collocations.example: He carried an expensive leather briefcase to every meeting.

definition: the flat part of a hat that sticks out around the edge

definition: the point just before a serious or dangerous situation begins

definition: to show sudden anger or annoyance at something

definition: to think anxiously or unhappily about something for a long time

definition: a small square piece of rich, soft chocolate cake

He brought a fresh batch of brownies to the office party.

definition: to look through a book, website, or shop without a clear plan

definition: a close friend

collocations.example: He has been a good buddy of mine since childhood.
He met an old buddy from school at the reunion.

definition: a meal where guests serve themselves from a variety of dishes

collocations.example: The conference included a free buffet lunch for all guests.
The hotel offers a generous breakfast buffet every morning.

definition: a small, usually sweet, round bread roll

collocations.example: She bought a warm cinnamon bun from the bakery.
She enjoyed a warm, sticky bun with her morning coffee.

definition: a house that has only one story

collocations.example: The retired couple bought a small bungalow by the sea.

definition: a strong underground shelter that protects against attack

definition: a child's word for a rabbit

definition: a floating object that marks a position on water

definition: a hole or tunnel in the ground made by an animal

definition: busy and noisy activity in a place

definition: a round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves

definition: a young person training to be an officer in the military or police

definition: a large desert animal with one or two humps on its back

definition: the group of works generally accepted as important and genuine

definition: a layer of spreading branches and leaves high in a forest

definition: to use a situation to gain an advantage for yourself

A good player will always capitalise on an opponent's mistake.

definition: a small container of medicine that you swallow whole

definition: the words printed beneath a picture to explain it

definition: a group of people and animals traveling together across a desert

definition: a public festival with music, dancing, and processions

definition: a religious song traditionally sung at Christmas

definition: soldiers who fight on horseback

definition: a large cave or underground chamber
